# XstReader Node Database

The Node Database, structure layouts, and crypt tables in this directory were adapted from Dijji/XstReader at commit 3b7856c8b3d01bdf8aa13744e476d1ef7761b832, under the Microsoft Public License.

Changes in this project allow reading from independent seekable views of the same verified read-only handle, require full reads, and bound index, data, and subnode traversal. The PST path accepts Unicode version 23 with no block encoding or permutation encoding. The OST path accepts 512-byte ANSI 14/15 and Unicode 21/23 pages with no block encoding, permutation encoding, or cyclic encoding. The 4 KiB OST path accepts Unicode 36 with block encoding 0 and optional zlib compression. Windows Information Protection encoding and encoded 4 KiB variants are outside the accepted set.

The OST path validates header, accessed index page, and allocated data block CRCs. It validates page and block references and signatures before decoding each externally encoded data block. Cyclic encoding uses the lower 32 bits of the block's BID. The 4 KiB path bounds zlib decoding to the stored block bytes and declared expanded length. LTP property and table reading lives in PstTables.cs, including ANSI table row offsets. Exported OST evidence contains decoded logical MAPI property values with the archived input hash and layout.

The 512-byte permutation path was checked against the public Aspose OST example (Unicode 23, client 12, block encoding 1). The ANSI 14/15 and cyclic Unicode 23 paths were checked using preparation controls derived from public sample files and compared with libpff. [Aspose fixture](https://github.com/aspose-email/Aspose.Email-for-.NET/blob/88cb2da311382bbbba6d14813127b0e6b3854c12/Examples/Data/MAPI/SampleOstFile.ost) · [Microsoft MS-PST header and block methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-pst/c9876f5a-664b-46a3-9887-ba63f113abf5) · [Microsoft cyclic block encoding](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_file_formats/ms-pst/9979fc01-0a3e-496f-900f-a6a867951f23) · [libpff Personal Folder File format](https://github.com/libyal/libpff/blob/main/documentation/Personal%20Folder%20File%20(PFF)%20format.asciidoc)
